scope: Complete routine extents 0x10003c40 through 0x10006a60, including the configuration dialog and console, plus RT_DIALOG/101 and VERSION/1 payloads.
status: Partial native source reconstruction; integrated DLL equality is not established.
source_structure: Private filenames remain inferred. Independent original initialized-data order, fourteen AMP dewindow copies, and Rich compiler counts constrain DirectSound/configuration to one native C unit (0x10003c40..0x10006610), followed by the separate AudioLog C unit. Configuration functions are placed between AudioTimer and StartAudio in original function order.
compiler: Tracked VC7 13.00.9466, native /O2 /Ob1 /MT. These options reproduce 57 of 60 complete aligned bodies; remaining routines may require different source or compilation context.

AudioError.finding: All fifteen known HRESULT cases match. The default path reloads the original text argument from its stack slot; current source reuses ESI.
probes: Using the parameter itself as the output message, using a separate message local, making the default MessageBox call directly, and parsing the HRESULT through va_list do not recover the original default path.
A volatile text parameter with a nonvolatile local message copy produces an exact native body. This qualifier is not adopted because original-source evidence for a volatile stack argument is missing.

AllocateSoundBuffer.finding: The original stores three immediate zero values before the memset register-zero operation; current source shares the zero register. Native source initialization and memset scheduling remain unresolved.
negative_hypotheses: All eight combinations of volatile qualification for CurrentPlayPosition, CurrentAudioLength and CurrentAudio were examined.
/Og- produces 99 bytes; /G5 still produces 80 bytes and worsens the instruction differences.

SubmitAudio.finding: Direct PendingBytes preparation references and a signed float sample-distance local recover original register use in the preparation block and the 0x2c stack frame. Remaining native differences involve cursor reads and integer/x87 scheduling.
probes: LARGE_INTEGER versus __int64 counter/frequency declarations and /Zp4 do not resolve the frame difference.
Two-DWORD counter structures accessed as signed 64-bit values do not alter the result.

Original 0x100052aa contains a dead load of its local write cursor. Volatile local play/write cursors preserve that load and reduce differing bytes to 273, but still leave the wrong stack frame and other scheduling differences. This remains a probe.

A separate float samples local, assigned from the signed cursor difference, restores the original 0x2c stack frame and exact x87 operation sequence. With volatile cursor locals this leaves 263 differing bytes, principally register/scheduling differences and branch-offset propagation; complete equality is not achieved.

Separate pending-byte and write-position locals, a copied length local, counter/frequency arrays, and relocating LastBlockLength assignment do not resolve the remaining differences. A double samples local or volatile LastBlockLength worsens the match.

layout_limits: All globals identified solely from observed operands remain explicitly tagged observed_operand_inference in the address map.
AudioIniSection is provisionally 128 bytes at 0x1016c240; its full original extent is unproved. A 256-byte declaration would overlap separately identified AudioUCode at 0x1016c300.
Initialized AudioDescription and AudioCredits pointers require integrated linker relocation/layout checks.
Literal strings with multiple full or suffix occurrences remain unresolved when not independently attributable.
Common zero initialization does not prove original symbol dimensions or a unique address.
resources: Readable CP1252 Audio.rc compiles to byte-exact complete dialog and version payloads. The resource directory and full PE layout remain integration work.

AudioSampleLoop.source_inference: Minimal short-sample load/writeback pass. Its compiler-eliminated expression is not uniquely recoverable.
negative_plain_loop_probes: Signed or unsigned int index against bytes/2; direct bytes>>1 and separately extracted unsigned count; long index/unsigned long bound.
Returning the index or bound computes the result without preserving the observed loop.
Native C++ produces the same eliminated 16-byte aligned routine as C.
/Og- retains a frame-based 38-byte loop. Register index plus register extracted bound under /Og- produces 46 bytes, not the observed 32-byte register loop.

initialized_data.DirectSound: Genuine transform.h array at0x10038b18, followed by the original-order description/credits/settings definitions. The two unreferenced initialized ints544 and1 have deliberately unknown-purpose private names. Final four-byte inter-contribution alignment remains linker work.
initialized_data.AudioLog: Genuine transform.h array at0x100393c8; no following initialized application data.
initialized_data.checked: Complete native initialized contributions match all2220 DirectSound and2176 AudioLog bytes after resolving the two independently identified literal-pointer relocations for comparison. All named data offsets match. This is an attributed diagnostic, not proof of final linker placement or whole-DLL equality.

storage_recovery: See analysis/audio-dsound-storage.json. Native explicit zero initialization preserves57 matches and recovers the first seven strong-BSS offsets;48 bytes of later DS state and a four-byte DS/Log boundary interval remain unexplained. Five shared storage definitions were coordinated into DirectSound. No gap-filling objects were introduced.
